page.layout: One scan showing the back cover of a book: speckled brown-orange boards with a cloth spine on the right and a paper spine label carrying asterisks and a partly visible call number. No printed text on the page.
page.notes: The scan shows the outside of the back board, not a printed page. The spine label contains only asterisk rows and a fragment of a handwritten or typed shelf mark ("H" and a partial figure), which is a library shelf mark and is left out. No printed text to transcribe.
